messages:
noah: quick flag  CI failed on regen+publish tonight, small params reorder in generated client broke sample-app smoke.

elsa: ugh. any stacktrace?

noah: gist: 
```
TypeError: client.addItem is not a function
 at app/dist/main.js:88
```

sam: regendiff shows `addItem(item, opts)` -> `addItem(opts, item)`. generator flipped overload ordering.

irene: did release-bot already touch changelog?

dev-bot: changelog PR #1533 created (level: minor) based on automated semver detection.

noah: that minor is wrong here; it's generator nondeterminism. We should revert the regen, run a deterministic regen, and then re-run publish smoke before letting release-bot decide.

elsa: agreed. short term: revert the typegen commit and land a compatibility shim in SDK to accept either ordering.

sam: compatibility shim is fine, but we must make generator stable. I'll open a ticket for stable overload ordering in the generator with a failing example.

irene: also saw auth/retry flakiness in same build which made the failure noisy. Can we add a deterministic retry harness so those tests are repeatable?

noah: yes. Add a harness that returns 429 twice then 200 so we can simulate and mark it flaky-guard.

sam: creating PRs: revert typegen -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/326; fallback-shim -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/812.

qa-bot: build 2180456789.1 (revert-typegen) started.

qa-bot: build 2180456789.1 passed  sample-app smoke publish OK.

noah: updated changelog to patch and closed minor PR. release-bot adjusted.

dev-bot: release artifacts for v1.9.0 (patch) created.

elsa: follow-ups: (1) implement pre-release smoke gate when files under `generated/` change; (2) add deterministic retry harness; (3) generator bug to prefer stable overload ordering. I'll add to the pipeline board.

noah: thanks team. closing once artifacts finish uploading.
